purpose: Non-destructively join the separately qualified visible-mode FACETS calibration layer to the frozen 48-attempt multi-vector preflight, then compute the four already-registered nonconfirmatory diagnostics from the original native-precision Python evidence.

join_contract.supplement_facets_rows_role: calibration-only separate tables with IncludedInStudy forced false
join_contract.joined_outcome_change: FACETSCalibrationReady is derived from the one-to-one supplemental marker; the original value and failure reason remain separately retained

precision_contract.scientific_diagnostics: Use only the original native-precision Python recovery and free-SD rows.
precision_contract.facets_measure_and_threshold_calibration: Use the qualified primary Umean=6 FACETS report and Scorefiles already parsed by the supplemental layer.
precision_contract.facets_fit_fields: Treat ordinary FACETS fit display fields as two-decimal displayed evidence only. Do not reconstruct, impute, or use them as unrounded calculation inputs.
precision_contract.rounding_aware_agreement: The registered FACETS/Python calibration gates tolerate display quantization and compare only like-for-like JMLE quantities.

endpoint_rule: Only after the join audit passes may the runner read and compute PF1-PF4 exactly as registered in the source plan. No p-values, endpoint substitution, direction change, or pooling with screening data is allowed.
claim_limit: This is a four-vector nonconfirmatory preflight plus same-estimand FACETS calibration. It cannot rank estimators, establish universal bias, confirm an effect, or support a public product claim.
